# The following code is an example of how one might begin to address some of the concepts:
# - biodiversity and ecological equilibrium
# - digital communication and information sharing
# - artistic expression analysis
# - knowledge pursuit through data
# - sustainability and environmental conservation

import random
import requests
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt

# Example function to analyze biodiversity data
def analyze_biodiversity(data):
    species_count = {region: len(species) for region, species in data.items()}
    plt.bar(species_count.keys(), species_count.values())
    plt.xlabel('Region')
    plt.ylabel('Number of Species')
    plt.title('Biodiversity by Region')
    plt.show()

# Example function to fetch digital communication data (dummy example, as it won't run without actual URLs)
def fetch_information(urls):
    information = []
    for url in urls:
        response = requests.get(url)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            information.append(response.text)
    return information

# Example function to analyze artistic expression through text analysis
def analyze_artistic_expression(texts):
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer()
    tfidf_matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform(texts)
    feature_names = vectorizer.get_feature_names_out()
    dense = tfidf_matrix.todense()
    denselist = dense.tolist()
    df = pd.DataFrame(denselist, columns=feature_names)
    print(df.head())

# Example function for simple sustainability efforts simulation
def simulate_sustainability_efforts(efforts):
    results = {effort: random.uniform(0.1, 1.0) for effort in efforts}
    plt.pie(results.values(), labels=results.keys(), autopct='%1.1f%%')
    plt.title('Impact of Sustainability Efforts')
    plt.show()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess
import time
import os
import sys

# Start a separate headless soffice instance with isolated profile and socket
profile_dir = "/tmp/lo_profile_concat"
subprocess.run(["rm", "-rf", profile_dir])
os.makedirs(profile_dir, exist_ok=True)

soffice_proc = subprocess.Popen([
    "soffice",
    "--headless",
    "--norestore",
    "--nologo",
    "--nodefault",
    "--nofirststartwizard",
    f"-env:UserInstallation=file://{profile_dir}",
    "--accept=socket,host=localhost,port=2202;urp;",
])

# Wait for soffice to start
import socket as sk
for i in range(30):
    try:
        s = sk.socket(sk.AF_INET, sk.SOCK_STREAM)
        s.connect(("localhost", 2202))
        s.close()
        break
    except Exception:
        time.sleep(0.5)
else:
    print("Failed to start soffice")
    sys.exit(1)

import uno
from com.sun.star.beans import PropertyValue

def make_prop(name, value):
    p = PropertyValue()
    p.Name = name
    p.Value = value
    return p

local_context = uno.getComponentContext()
resolver = local_context.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext(
    "com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver", local_context)

ctx = resolver.resolve(
    "uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2202;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext")
smgr = ctx.ServiceManager
desktop = smgr.createInstanceWithContext("com.sun.star.frame.Desktop", ctx)

# Create new Writer document
doc = desktop.loadComponentFromURL(
    "private:factory/swriter", "_blank", 0,
    tuple([make_prop("Hidden", True)]))

# Read merged content
with open("/tmp/merged.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()

text = doc.getText()
cursor = text.createTextCursor()
text.insertString(cursor, content, False)

# Select all and set font size to 10
cursor_all = text.createTextCursor()
cursor_all.gotoStart(False)
cursor_all.gotoEnd(True)
cursor_all.CharHeight = 10
cursor_all.CharHeightAsian = 10
cursor_all.CharHeightComplex = 10

# Also set default style font size to 10 (covers any new text)
styles = doc.getStyleFamilies().getByName("ParagraphStyles")
default_style = styles.getByName("Default Paragraph Style") if styles.hasByName("Default Paragraph Style") else styles.getByName("Standard")
default_style.CharHeight = 10
default_style.CharHeightAsian = 10
default_style.CharHeightComplex = 10

# Save as docx on Desktop
output_url = "file:///home/user/Desktop/concat.docx"
save_props = (
    make_prop("FilterName", "MS Word 2007 XML"),
    make_prop("Overwrite", True),
)
doc.storeToURL(output_url, save_props)
doc.close(True)

# Terminate soffice
try:
    desktop.terminate()
except Exception:
    pass
soffice_proc.wait(timeout=10)
print("Done")
